languages.selection: ?lang= wins, then an explicit /en/ path, then the scoped pwa_lang cookie. Language links preserve the current page and its shop filters.
languages.content: One JSON-valued admin_settings row per bilingual editorial text; domain tables carry explicit _en columns. text_<key>_<lang> rows override any dictionary key at render time.

design.thesis: A school-supply store, so the page itself is a notebook: sky-blue ruled lines with one coral margin line open the hero and every section head, mark the active nav item and separate ideas. Sunshine-yellow stickers carry prices and badges — the one loud thing on an otherwise white, airy page. Rounded display type (Baloo 2) keeps it fun without shouting.
design.paletteRationale: The brief asked for sky blue and a fun mood. Sky blue is the brand and every primary action; sunshine yellow is reserved for prices, badges and the school-list call to action; coral appears only as the notebook margin line and for out-of-stock. Navy replaces black for all text so the page never goes hard.
design.type: Baloo 2 700/800 for display, Nunito 400/700/800 for body and UI.
design.structure: 1180px container, one image ratio per card type (products 1:1, categories 4:3, school lists 16:10), pill buttons with a hard 3px shadow, 52px minimum control height.
design.signatureMove: The --ruled background (32px sky ruling + coral margin at 56px) used by .hero, .section--ruled, .rule, .cat-media and every image placeholder; .sticker for prices.
design.imagery: Studio-generated flat illustrations in one shared style (see lib/assets.js). They illustrate categories of school supplies; none is a photograph presented as a specific product. The owner replaces any of them from the admin area.
deviations: The mobile drawer opens from the left: a fixed panel parked off-canvas to the right counts toward document scroll width in Chrome.
No backdrop-filter on the header below the drawer breakpoint: a filtered ancestor traps fixed descendants.

pages.job: Promise, categories, the four school lists, essentials, how it works
One product, its options and add-to-cart (only once its price is confirmed)
One list with quantities and a one-click add-all
Review the basket and place an order
One order, its totals, tracking and PayPal payment
Pickup, delivery and the short FAQ
The owner-approved privacy notice and terms of sale

redirects.note: Every canonical page also answers on its bare (no trailing slash) form with a 301. The router runs with Express strict routing precisely so those redirects cannot match the canonical URL and loop.

tables.seeding: STARTER STORE, not facts about the business: 7 categories, 25 representative products with typical prices all marked price_verified=0, and 4 school lists. No hours, no address, no phone were seeded because the brief gave none. No fabricated customer, order, payment or review records. The platform _seed_version sentinel prevents reseeding over edited content.

priceConfirmation.implementation: products.price_verified (0 by default). The site shows « Prix à confirmer » with no number, hides add-to-cart, and lib/orders.js price() rejects the basket with price_unconfirmed_error (409) whatever the row says. The admin form refuses to confirm a zero price.
priceConfirmation.why: The catalogue was created by the studio from a one-paragraph brief. No price in it was ever stated by the owner, so none may be charged until the owner ticks it. The dashboard counts what is left.

schoolLists.model: bundles.items is a JSON array of 'product-slug x quantity' lines; lib/admin.js normalises what the owner types and drops malformed lines.
schoolLists.addAll: Only items that are in stock, price-confirmed and without a colour/size choice are added in one click; the page says so and links the rest to their own page.

categories.implementation: A categories table the owner can extend. lib/modules.js receives the current category slugs so the products form's select and lib/admin.js validation always match. A category still holding products cannot be deleted (409).

shop.cart: Held in the visitor's own browser (localStorage key sh_cart_v1, guarded for private windows). It carries only slug, chosen option and quantity.
shop.pricing: Every amount is computed server-side in lib/orders.js from the products table. The browser never sends a price. Options are validated against the product's own list, and an out-of-stock, unpublished or unconfirmed item fails the whole basket.
shop.taxes: GST and QST are read from admin_settings in basis points (500 / 998 by default) and applied to the pre-tax amount including shipping. Printed books are seeded taxable=0 (QST-exempt); the owner adjusts per product.
shop.fulfilment: Pickup is always offered and always free. Shipping only appears once the owner has both enabled it and entered a rate — no delivery price is ever invented. Orders carry a tracking field the owner fills when shipped.
shop.idempotency: A per-basket request key plus a UNIQUE(user_id, request_key) constraint makes a double submit return the original order instead of creating a second one.

payments.provider: PayPal Orders v2, Payments v2 and the official JavaScript SDK v6
checks: Fixed CAD amount read from the database, never from the browser
Merchant id, order id and CAPTURE intent
Capture currency, gross amount and final_capture
Credential and environment bound to the row at order creation
Stable create and capture request ids so a retry cannot double-charge
payments.recovery: Customer-triggered sync, an owner reconcile endpoint, and a five-minute GET-only background reconciliation. An order whose creation attempt is older than five hours stops for manual review instead of risking a second order.
payments.webhooks: Not used. No unsigned webhook endpoint exists.
payments.setupBoundary: payments_enabled, payment_terms_approved and live_actions_enabled all start off, and preview mode always suppresses charging.

capabilities: A launch checklist of everything still switched off, starting with the unconfirmed prices
admin.security: Every admin page and API checks services.admin.isAdmin. Writes require a same-origin request and an explicit X-Requested-With header. Orders cannot be created by hand, amounts are read-only, and an order that has reached PayPal cannot be deleted.
admin.sdk: The platform does not inject its SDK on /admin pages; App.request() in public/js/app.js uses TenantSDK when present and a plain same-origin fetch otherwise, so every admin write works.

gates.principle: Anything that speaks for the business or spends money is off until the owner turns it on from Réglages.

pwa.push: Only after a real interaction: eight seconds after the first scroll or pointer event, and only when notifications are enabled. The footer also carries an explicit button.
pwa.private: Cart, order and admin responses are no-store. No payment result is ever inferred offline.

source.brief: Project: New website — e-commerce. Business: Souhoud, sells school supplies (notebooks, books, bags, suitcases, etc.). Goal: Sell school supplies directly to customers online. Key features: online payments / secure checkout, product catalog / gallery. Design: sky blue, fun; signature « The go-to place for school supply shopping »; the studio creates the visual look and images.
source.note: No source site, photographs, catalogue, address, phone or opening hours were supplied.

gaps: Every product price is a placeholder marked unconfirmed; the owner must check each one and tick « Prix confirmé » before it can be sold.
The catalogue is a representative starter set (25 products in 7 categories). The owner adds, renames and removes items from /admin/products.
Pickup address, phone number and pickup hours were not in the brief and are not seeded; the site says they will be confirmed.
Shipping rate: none exists. Pickup only until the owner enters a rate and enables shipping.
Terms of sale are empty; PayPal keys are not set. Online payment stays off until both are done.
The About text is a modest description derived from the brief; the owner should personalise it.
Illustrations are studio placeholders in a shared style; the owner may replace any with a real photo from the admin area.
